original-specifications.lookup_fallback_yaml:
schema_version: '1.0'
domain: TEST
base: SRC
keys: [ID]
input:

  DONOR: {path: donor.csv, types: {ID: int, SEQ: int}}
output: {path: result.csv, columns: [ID, A, B]}
intermediates:
  - id: P
    dataset: DONOR
    order_by: [DONOR.SEQ]
    keep: first
    no_match: {literal: null}
columns:
  - {name: ID, type: int, derivation: SRC.ID}
  - {name: SELECT, type: str, derivation: SRC.SELECT}
  - name: A
    type: str
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "SELECT = 'Y'"
          then: P.A
        - otherwise: {literal: skip}
  - name: B
    type: str
    derivation:
      case:
        - when: "SELECT = 'Y'"
          then: P.B
        - otherwise: {literal: skip}

temporal_arithmetic.name: pk_relative_times_and_vomiting_window
temporal_arithmetic.spec:
schema_version: '1.0'
domain: ADPC
base: PC
keys:
- USUBJID
- PCSEQ
input:
  PC:
    path: pc.csv
    types:
      PCSEQ: int
      PCDTC: datetime
  EX:
    path: ex.csv
    types:
      EXSTDTC: datetime
output:
  path: result.csv
  columns:
  - USUBJID
  - PCSEQ
  - AFRLT
  - SECONDS
  - PLAN
  - INWIN
  decimals: 2
intermediates:
- id: FIRSTDOSE
  dataset: EX
  order_by:
  - EX.EXSTDTC
  keep: first
columns:
- name: USUBJID
  type: str
  label: Subject
  derivation: PC.USUBJID
- name: PCSEQ
  type: int
  label: Sequence
  derivation: PC.PCSEQ
- name: ADTM
  type: datetime
  label: Sample
  derivation: PC.PCDTC
- name: FANLDTM
  type: datetime
  label: First dose
  derivation: FIRSTDOSE.EXSTDTC
- name: PLTS
  type: int
  label: Planned seconds
  derivation:
    duration_value:
      source: PC.PCELTM
      unit: second
- name: WINDOW
  type: datetime
  label: Window end
  derivation:
    shift:
      type: datetime
      source: FANLDTM
      amount: 4
      unit: hour
- name: AFRLT
  type: float
  label: Relative hours
  derivation:
    diff:
      type: datetime
      start: FANLDTM
      end: ADTM
      unit: hour
- name: SECONDS
  type: int
  label: Relative seconds
  derivation:
    diff:
      type: datetime
      start: FANLDTM
      end: ADTM
      unit: second
- name: PLAN
  type: datetime
  label: Planned sample
  derivation:
    shift:
      type: datetime
      source: FANLDTM
      amount: PLTS
      unit: second
- name: INWIN
  type: str
  label: Within four hours
  derivation:
    flag:
      condition: ADTM >= FANLDTM and ADTM <= WINDOW
      false_value: N
      missing: {literal: null}

intermediate_row_drivers.name: original_no_applicable_key
intermediate_row_drivers.specification:
schema_version: '1.0'
domain: ADLBC
input:
  LB:
    path: input/lb.csv
    types:
      STUDYID: str
      USUBJID: str
      LBTESTCD: str
      LBSEQ: int
      VISITNUM: int
      LBSTRESN: float
keys:
- K
output:
  path: out.csv
  columns:
  - K
  - STUDYID
  - USUBJID
  - LBTESTCD
  - LBSEQ
  - AVAL
columns:
- name: K
  type: int
- name: STUDYID
  type: str
- name: USUBJID
  type: str
- name: LBTESTCD
  type: str
- name: LBSEQ
  type: int
- name: AVAL
  type: float
intermediates:
- id: EOTFB
  dataset: LB
  derivations:
    _EOT_AWARE:
      case:
      - when: LB.VISITNUM = 9
        then:
          literal: 99
      - otherwise:
          source: LB.VISITNUM
    _RN:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by:
          - STUDYID
          - USUBJID
          - LBTESTCD
          order_by:
          - variable: _EOT_AWARE
            direction: desc
          - variable: LBSEQ
  filter: LB._RN = 1 AND LB._EOT_AWARE <> 99
  columns:
  - STUDYID
  - USUBJID
  - LBTESTCD
  - LBSEQ
  - VISITNUM
  - LBSTRESN
rows:
- id: eot2
  dataset: EOTFB
  filter: EOTFB.VISITNUM <> 12
  derivations:
    K:
      source: EOTFB.LBSEQ
    STUDYID:
      source: EOTFB.STUDYID
    USUBJID:
      source: EOTFB.USUBJID
    LBTESTCD:
      source: EOTFB.LBTESTCD
    LBSEQ:
      source: EOTFB.LBSEQ
    AVAL:
      source: EOTFB.LBSTRESN

domain: TEST
input: {SRC: {path: src.csv, types: {V: int, G: int}}}
keys: [K]
output: {path: out.csv, columns: [K]}
columns: [{name: K, type: int}]
intermediates:
  - id: P
    dataset: SRC
    filter: SRC.V > 1
  - id: Q
    dataset: SRC
    key: {V: {literal: 3}}

rows:
  - id: driver
    dataset: P
    derivations: {K: {source: P.V}}

intermediate_row_drivers.name: mixed_driver_compatible_lookup
intermediate_row_drivers.specification:
schema_version: '1.0'
domain: TEST
input: {SRC: {path: src.csv, types: {K: int, V: int}}}
keys: [K]
output: {path: out.csv, columns: [K, A]}
columns: [{name: K, type: int}, {name: A, type: int}]
intermediates: [{id: P, dataset: SRC, filter: SRC.V > 0}]
rows:
  - id: driver
    dataset: P
    filter: P.V = 3
    derivations: {K: {source: P.K}, A: {source: P.V}}
  - id: lookup
    dataset: SRC
    filter: SRC.V = 4
    derivations: {K: {source: SRC.K}, A: {source: P.V}}

diagnostic_sites.name: original_odm_vendor_filter
diagnostic_sites.specification:
schema_version: '1.0'
domain: VS
keys:
- STUDYID
- USUBJID
- VISIT
input:
  ODM:
    path: input/odm.csv
  DM:
    path: input/dm.csv
base: ODM
output:
  path: vs.csv
  columns:
  - STUDYID
  - USUBJID
  - VISIT
  - VSDTC
rows:
- id: VISITS
  dataset: ODM
  group_by:
  - ODM.StudyOID
  - ODM.SubjectKey
  - ODM.StudyEventOID
  derivations:
    STUDYID: ODM.StudyOID
    USUBJID: ODM.SubjectKey
    VISIT: ODM.StudyEventOID
columns:
- name: STUDYID
  type: str
  label: Study Identifier
- name: USUBJID
  type: str
  label: Subject
- name: VISIT
  type: str
  label: Visit
- name: VSDTC
  type: str
  label: Date
  derivation:
    odm:
      item: ODM.IT.VS.DATE
      filter: ODM.SITEID = '9'

domain: ADQS

      STUDYID: str
      USUBJID: str
      QSTESTCD: str
      QSCAT: str
      QSORRES: str
output:
  path: adqs.csv

  - USUBJID
  - AVAL
keys:
- STUDYID
- USUBJID
columns:
- name: STUDYID
  type: str
  derivation:
    source: QS.STUDYID
- name: USUBJID
  type: str
  derivation:
    source: QS.USUBJID
- name: AVAL
  type: float
  derivation:

      key:
      - STUDYID
      - USUBJID
      derive:

        derivation: XX.YY
      expr: SUM(A)
rows:
- id: subscale
  filter: QS.QSCAT = 'SCALE' AND QS.QSTESTCD = 'PF01'
  derivations: {}

diagnostic_sites.name: original_fieldless_count_filter_key_type

schema_version: '1.0'
domain: OUT
input:
  SRC: {path: src.csv, types: {N: int}}
  OTHER: {path: other.csv, types: {N: int}}
base: SRC
keys: [K]
output: {path: out.csv, columns: [K, V]}
columns:
  - name: V
    type: int
    derivation:
      aggregate:
        expr: COUNT(OTHER.*)
        key: {N: {literal: true}}
        filter: OTHER.N > 0
  - {name: K, type: int, derivation: SRC.N}

    types:

  dataset: TAB

  no_match: {literal: null}
columns:

  type: str
  derivation: SRC.ID
- name: V
  type: str
  derivation: LOOK.VAL
- name: V2
  type: str
